source_refs.note: Unnumbered heading 'Evaluating and Improving Solutions' (PDF 26); no figure. The check question is added.

blocks.text: After finding a solution, it is important to evaluate it. Evaluation checks whether the solution is correct and lets us find and fix mistakes. Testing the solution shows whether it works properly.

items: Test: does it work properly in practice?
Fix: find and correct the mistakes.
Improve: make the solution simpler or faster.

blocks.text: This process helps us learn from errors, and improving solutions leads to better performance. Evaluation is an important part of problem solving.

blocks.prompt: The tea algorithm in Figure 2.2 is tested and the tea is cold when served. Which step would you check first, and how could the algorithm be improved?
blocks.explanation: Check the steps between boiling and serving: the water may have cooled while the tea steeped too long, or the milk may have been cold. An improvement is to state the steeping time (for example a few minutes) and to warm the milk, so the steps give the same result every time.

items: Evaluate a solution: check, test, fix, improve.
Evaluation helps us learn from errors and gives better performance.
